bind the downstream VS2 construction sequence

profile_identity.profile_purpose: Define the smallest lawful vertical circuit capable, after later construction, construction verification, and separate execution authorization, of attempting one bounded typed-state contract target, emitting move-, case-, and run-level receipts, and exposing useful Confirmation Yield or Diagnostic Yield.

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: later explicit bounded contract for scope, regime, identity, sameness/difference, authority, claim, source, and transformation boundaries
component_profile_table.supported_function: declare the external governing frame for the bounded target run
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no scope/regime implementation schema is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: freeze four distinct roles: declared scope/regime, runtime control state, candidate contract, and frozen target contract
component_profile_table.supported_function: separate runtime control state, candidate contract, and frozen target contract under an external scope/regime frame
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no runtime, candidate, or target implementation schema is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: finite, versioned, target-bound, scope/regime-bound, source-bound, authority-bound, fixture-set-bound, non-reusable move space
component_profile_table.supported_function: bound all future transformations to one declared target family and first target
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no move-space implementation artifact is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: later selector enumerates admissible moves, selects exactly one move, or exposes no admissible move without mutation or invention
component_profile_table.supported_function: separate move enumeration/selection from mutation
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no selector contract is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: later applicator applies only the selected declared candidate delta or emits a typed application stop
component_profile_table.supported_function: create a bounded candidate version without selecting another move or inventing fields, sources, schemas, capabilities, or authority
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no applicator contract is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: future distinct authority classes for source admission, definition, construction, fixtures, readiness, verification, execution, sweep, rerun, expansion, revision, promotion, and reuse
component_profile_table.supported_function: prevent construction authority from becoming execution, rerun, expansion, reuse, or promotion authority
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no new authority is created by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: explicit caps with zero automatic renewal
component_profile_table.supported_function: bound future cases, moves, radius, budget, and rerun behavior
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no execution package is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: typed halts for target reached, missing inputs, authority/capability gaps, exhausted budget, no move, validation/admissibility failures, forbidden effects, identity or scope failures, non-progress, repeated state, convergence unmet, and unclassified results
component_profile_table.supported_function: contain future runs without hidden continuation
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no halt implementation is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: move-attempt receipt, case-terminal receipt, and sweep/run report without unrestricted private reasoning trace
component_profile_table.supported_function: preserve evidence for every bounded move and terminal outcome
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no receipt contract implementation is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: declared source identity with no automatic source acquisition, latest-file selection, mtime authority, directory-position authority, silent replacement, ambient context, or chat-memory sourcing
component_profile_table.supported_function: keep source identity exact and auditable
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no source snapshot is frozen by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: one later bounded sweep package for pressure exposure, outcome distinguishability, receipt validation, and boundary testing
component_profile_table.supported_function: bound the future first-run package without optimization sweep authority
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no sweep package is constructed or authorized by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: prevent or detect all frozen forbidden behaviors
component_profile_table.supported_function: guard against unbounded execution, mutation, authority escalation, reuse, portability, and false convergence
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no guard implementation is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: escalate rather than continue on missing authority, schema, capability, source expansion, move-space expansion, radius expansion, budget expansion, rerun, refinement, or unclassified outcome
component_profile_table.supported_function: keep missing authority and ambiguity human-bounded
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no autonomous continuation authority is created by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: explicit continue, repeat, non-progress, repeated-state, oscillation, cycle, radius, target-reached, and typed halt boundaries
component_profile_table.supported_function: preserve movement/progress/target/convergence distinctions
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no convergence criterion implementation is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: minimal report of what reached target, what was preserved, what stopped, why it stopped, and which gap appeared
component_profile_table.supported_function: support Confirmation Yield or Diagnostic Yield reporting
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no pressure report is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: freeze the initial pressure classification vocabulary
component_profile_table.supported_function: separate pressure classification from validation, admissibility, convergence, and terminal outcome namespaces
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no taxonomy mutation is authorized by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: minimal exact-input, exact-delta, terminal-outcome, budget, target-immutability, and unexpected-mutation verification
component_profile_table.supported_function: make future evidence replayable enough for the first target
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no replay implementation is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: emit Confirmation Yield or Diagnostic Yield
component_profile_table.supported_function: classify useful evidence even when the target is not reached
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: no Evidence Yield report is constructed by VS2.2

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: deferred local revision surface may later emit a refinement candidate but may not apply it
component_profile_table.supported_function: preserve future Diagnostic Yield without automatic repair
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: local revision is deferred and not satisfied by this profile

component_profile_table.profile_requirement: deferred portability map with no first-target portability claim
component_profile_table.supported_function: preserve portability as out of scope for this first target
component_profile_table.omitted_or_deferred_function: portability is deferred and not satisfied by this profile

bounded_construction_package_contains_on: one source identity and freshness policy

may: verify the complete bounded construction package
